questions.subject: PHYSICS_MECHANICS
questions.topic: Defining equation of simple harmonic motion
questions.learningObjective: State the defining equation of SHM
questions.stem: Which equation defines simple harmonic motion?
questions.explanation: SHM requires acceleration proportional and opposite to displacement: a = -omega^2 x. Positive sign or velocity forms are wrong.

questions.explanation: Ideal spring period T = 2pi sqrt(m/k) is independent of amplitude. Mass and k do affect it.

questions.explanation: T = 2pi sqrt(m/k) = 2pi sqrt(0.5/2) = 2pi*0.5 = 3.14 s.
